+class DimResolutionError(ValueError):
+    """A symbolic shape dimension has no concrete value."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RooflineOp:
+    """One exported op's roofline projection."""
+
+    name: str
+    section: str
+    computation: str
+    operation: str
+    category: str | None
+    """PerfModel family name (``"GEMM"``, ``"SDPA"``, ...), or ``None`` when unmodeled."""
+    modeled: bool
+    reason: str | None
+    """Why this op is unmodeled (``None`` when ``modeled`` is ``True``)."""
+    output_elements: int | None
+    instances: int
+    """How many real layers this op's section represents (layer-repeat scaling)."""
+    flops: float | None = None
+    bytes: float | None = None
+    compute_spec: str | None = None
+    roofline_time_us: float | None = None
+    roofline_bound: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def total_flops(self) -> float | None:
+        return None if self.flops is None else self.flops * self.instances
+
+    @property
+    def total_bytes(self) -> float | None:
+        return None if self.bytes is None else self.bytes * self.instances
+
+    @property
+    def total_roofline_time_us(self) -> float | None:
+        return (
+            None
+            if self.roofline_time_us is None
+            else self.roofline_time_us * self.instances
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RooflineProjection:
+    """Full-model roofline projection: every op plus a model-level rollup."""
+
+    ops: list[RooflineOp] = field(default_factory=list)
+    batch_size: int = 1
+    seq_len: int = 0
+
+    @property
+    def modeled_ops(self) -> list[RooflineOp]:
+        return [op for op in self.ops if op.modeled]
+
+    @property
+    def unmodeled_ops(self) -> list[RooflineOp]:
+        return [op for op in self.ops if not op.modeled]
+
+    def totals(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Model-level rollup: FLOPs, bytes, roofline time, and coverage."""
+        modeled = self.modeled_ops
+        total_flops = sum(op.total_flops or 0 for op in modeled)
+        total_bytes = sum(op.total_bytes or 0 for op in modeled)
+        bound_ops = [op for op in modeled if op.roofline_time_us is not None]
+        total_roofline_time_us = sum(op.total_roofline_time_us or 0 for op in bound_ops)
+        compute_bound_time_us = sum(
+            op.total_roofline_time_us or 0
+            for op in bound_ops
+            if op.roofline_bound == "COMPUTE_BOUND"
+        )
+        memory_bound_time_us = sum(
+            op.total_roofline_time_us or 0
+            for op in bound_ops
+            if op.roofline_bound == "MEMORY_BOUND"
+        )
+        modeled_elements = sum(
+            (op.output_elements or 0) * op.instances for op in modeled
+        )
+        unmodeled_elements = sum(
+            (op.output_elements or 0) * op.instances for op in self.unmodeled_ops
+        )
+        total_elements = modeled_elements + unmodeled_elements
+        return {
+            "batch_size": self.batch_size,
+            "seq_len": self.seq_len,
+            "total_flops": total_flops,
+            "total_bytes": total_bytes,
+            "total_roofline_time_us": total_roofline_time_us,
+            "compute_bound_time_us": compute_bound_time_us,
+            "memory_bound_time_us": memory_bound_time_us,
+            "modeled_op_count": len(modeled),
+            "unmodeled_op_count": len(self.unmodeled_ops),
+            "modeled_output_element_share": (
+                modeled_elements / total_elements if total_elements else None
+            ),
+        }
+
+
+def resolve_dim(dim: int | str, dims: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    """Resolve one shape dimension (an int, a symbol, or a ``*``/``+`` expression).
+
+    A negative int (an unfolded ``-1`` reshape placeholder) is treated as
+    unresolved rather than used literally, since a literal ``-1`` would
+    silently corrupt any FLOPs/bytes product it enters.
+    """
+    if isinstance(dim, int):
+        if dim < 0:
+            raise DimResolutionError(str(dim))
+        return dim
+    text = str(dim)
+    if "+" in text:
+        return sum(resolve_dim(term, dims) for term in text.split("+"))
+    if "*" in text:
+        result = 1
+        for factor in text.split("*"):
+            result *= resolve_dim(factor, dims)
+        return result
+    if text.lstrip("-").isdigit():
+        return int(text)
+    if text not in dims:
+        raise DimResolutionError(text)
+    value = dims[text]
+    if value == text:
+        raise DimResolutionError(text)
+    return resolve_dim(value, dims)
+
+
+def resolve_shape(shape: list[Any], dims: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    return tuple(resolve_dim(dim, dims) for dim in shape)
+
+
+def build_projection_dims(
+    spec: ArchitectureSpec,
+    *,
+    batch_size: int,
+    seq_len: int,
+    extra_dims: dict[str, int] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Concrete dims dict: config dims plus batch/seq and any ``--dim`` overrides."""
+    context = ShapeContext.from_spec(spec)
+    dims: dict[str, Any] = dict(context.dims)
+    dims["B"] = batch_size
+    dims["S"] = seq_len
+    dims.update(extra_dims or {})
+    return dims
+
+
+def project_roofline(
+    spec: ArchitectureSpec,
+    *,
+    batch_size: int,
+    seq_len: int,
+    extra_dims: dict[str, int] | None = None,
+    gpu_arch: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    checkpoint: str | Path | None = None,
+) -> RooflineProjection:
+    """Project a kernel-by-kernel roofline for *spec* at a concrete batch/seq length.
+
+    Builds the same merged Model Explorer graph the visualizer draws, with
+    expansion stopped at roofline-formula ops (:func:`build_roofline_basic_ops`)
+    and, when ``spec.parallel_layout`` is set, the same ``--tp``/``--pp``/``--ep``
+    split and per-GPU local shapes the visualizer would show for that layout.
+    """
+    dims = build_projection_dims(
+        spec, batch_size=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len, extra_dims=extra_dims
+    )
+    _populate_introspection(spec)
+    moe_top_k = spec.num_experts_per_tok
+    moe_intermediate_size = spec.moe_intermediate_size or spec.intermediate_size
+    payload = build_model_explorer_payload(
+        spec,
+        basic_ops=build_roofline_basic_ops(),
+        include_shapes=True,
+        # The nested stage tree and the concrete spatial shapes are read off a
+        # meta-device module. Without the checkpoint the projection builds the
+        # uniform-stack graph and a CNN's stage body never appears.
+        meta_shapes_checkpoint=str(checkpoint) if checkpoint else None,
+    )
+    graphs = payload["graphCollections"][0]["graphs"]
+    nodes = graphs[0]["nodes"] if graphs else []
+
+    result = RooflineProjection(batch_size=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len)
+    for node in nodes:
+        if not isinstance(node, dict):
+            continue
+        parsed = _parse_op_node(node)
+        if parsed is None:
+            continue
+        (
+            section,
+            computation,
+            class_name,
+            operation,
+            output_text,
+            input_texts,
+            role,
+            details,
+        ) = parsed
+        instances = _repeat_count(str(node.get("namespace") or ""), node)
+        result.ops.append(
+            _project_op(
+                str(node.get("id")),
+                section,
+                computation,
+                class_name,
+                operation,
+                output_text,
+                input_texts,
+                dims,
+                instances,
+                gpu_arch,
+                moe_top_k,
+                moe_intermediate_size,
+                role,
+                details,
+            )
+        )
+    return result
+
+
+def _repeat_count(namespace: str, node: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> int:
+    """How many times the exported node stands for a live module.
+
+    A ``repeat_count`` attr wins. The stage body stamps its depth there, and a
+    submodule that exists only on the first element (a ResNet projection
+    shortcut) stamps ``1`` so the stage depth does not multiply it. Otherwise
+    the innermost ``{N}x_`` / ``s{stage}_{N}x_`` namespace segment, or 1.
+    """
+    stamped = _attr_text((node or {}).get("attrs"), "repeat_count")
+    if stamped and str(stamped).isdigit():
+        return int(stamped)
+    count = 1
+    for segment in namespace.split("/"):
+        match = _REPEAT_NAMESPACE_SEGMENT.match(segment)
+        if match:
+            count = int(match.group(1))
+    return count
+
+
+def _attr_text(attrs: Any, key: str) -> str | None:
+    if not isinstance(attrs, list):
+        return None
+    return next(
+        (item.get("value") for item in attrs if item.get("key") == key),
+        None,
+    )
+
+
+def _parse_op_node(
+    node: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[str, str, str, str, str, list[list[str]]] | None:
+    """``(section, computation, class_name, operation, output_shape_text,
+    input_shape_lists)`` for *node*.
+
+    ``None`` for a node that carries no computation of its own: an
+    ``@input``/``@output`` boundary port, a host-side scalar source, or a
+    collective TraceLens inserted for a device-partition split.
+    """
+    node_id = str(node.get("id") or "")
+    if _NON_COMPUTE_ID_MARKER in node_id:
+        return None
+    attrs = node.get("attrs")
+    computation = _attr_text(attrs, "op_type")
+    if not computation:
+        return None
+    class_name = _attr_text(attrs, "class_name") or ""
+    if any(marker in class_name for marker in _ENGINE_LINEAR_CLASS_MARKERS):
+        computation = "Linear"
+    operation = _attr_text(attrs, "operation") or ""
+    output_text = _attr_text(attrs, "output_shape")
+    if not output_text:
+        return None
+    input_shapes_json = _attr_text(attrs, "input_shapes")
+    input_texts: list[list[str]] = (
+        json.loads(input_shapes_json) if input_shapes_json else []
+    )
+    namespace = str(node.get("namespace") or "")
+    section = namespace.split("/")[-1] if namespace else node_id
+    role = _attr_text(attrs, "role") or ""
+    details = _attr_text(attrs, "details") or ""
+    return (
+        section,
+        computation,
+        class_name,
+        operation,
+        output_text,
+        input_texts,
+        role,
+        details,
+    )
+
+
+def _project_op(
+    node_id: str,
+    section: str,
+    computation: str,
+    class_name: str,
+    operation: str,
+    output_text: str,
+    input_texts: list[list[str]],
+    dims: dict[str, Any],
+    instances: int,
+    gpu_arch: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    moe_top_k: int | None,
+    moe_intermediate_size: int | None,
+    role: str = "",
+    details: str = "",
+) -> RooflineOp:
+    base = RooflineOp(
+        name=node_id,
+        section=section,
+        computation=computation,
+        operation=operation,
+        category=None,
+        modeled=False,
+        reason=None,
+        output_elements=None,
+        instances=instances,
+    )
+    _dims_only, dtype = _split_shape_text(output_text)
+    bpe = _BYTES_PER_ELEMENT.get(torch_dtype_map(dtype)) if dtype else None
+
+    # Introspective boundaries: the modeling source tags each module with a role
+    # ("attention"/"ffn") and the arch spec says whether the model is MoE, so we
+    # cost the custom attention and routed-expert blocks without matching names.
+    if role == "attention":
+        att = _attention_boundary_cost(dims, bpe)
+        if att is not None:
+            category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved = att
+            try:
+                oshape = resolve_shape(_dims_only, dims)
+                base.output_elements = prod(oshape) if oshape else 1
+            except DimResolutionError:
+                base.output_elements = None
+            return _finish_op(
+                base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch
+            )
+    if role == "ffn" and _RT.moe_top_k and "moe" in class_name.lower():
+        moe = _moe_cost(dims, _RT.moe_top_k, _RT.moe_intermediate, bpe)
+        if moe is not None:
+            category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, output_elements = moe
+            base.output_elements = output_elements
+            return _finish_op(
+                base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch
+            )
+
+    engine_cost = _engine_boundary_cost(
+        class_name, dims, moe_top_k, moe_intermediate_size, bpe
+    )
+    if engine_cost is not None:
+        category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, output_elements = engine_cost
+        base.output_elements = output_elements
+        return _finish_op(base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch)
+
+    try:
+        output_shape = resolve_shape(_dims_only, dims)
+        base.output_elements = prod(output_shape) if output_shape else 1
+    except DimResolutionError as exc:
+        base.reason = f"unresolved output dim {exc}"
+        return base
+
+    try:
+        input_shapes = [
+            resolve_shape(shape, dims) if shape else None for shape in input_texts
+        ]
+        cost = _dispatch_op_cost(computation, input_shapes, output_shape, bpe, details)
+    except DimResolutionError as exc:
+        base.reason = f"unresolved input dim {exc}"
+        return base
+
+    if cost is None:
+        base.reason = f"no PerfModel mapping for computation={computation!r}"
+        return base
+
+    category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved = cost
+    return _finish_op(base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch)
+
+
+def _finish_op(
+    base: RooflineOp,
+    category: str,
+    maf_type: str,
+    flops: float,
+    bytes_moved: float | None,
+    dtype: str | None,
+    gpu_arch: dict[str, Any] | None,
+) -> RooflineOp:
+    base.category = category
+    base.modeled = True
+    base.flops = flops
+    base.bytes = bytes_moved
+
+    precision = torch_dtype_map(dtype) if dtype else None
+    if precision is not None:
+        base.compute_spec = f"{maf_type}_{precision}"
+    if gpu_arch is not None and base.compute_spec is not None and flops:
+        peak_tflops = (gpu_arch.get("max_achievable_tflops") or {}).get(
+            base.compute_spec
+        )
+        mem_bw_gbps = gpu_arch.get("mem_bw_gbps")
+        gflops = flops / 1e9
+        roofline_time_us, roofline_bound = compute_roofline_time_and_bound(
+            gflops, bytes_moved, peak_tflops, mem_bw_gbps
+        )
+        base.roofline_time_us = roofline_time_us
+        base.roofline_bound = roofline_bound
+    return base
+
+
+def _engine_boundary_cost(
+    class_name: str,
+    dims: dict[str, Any],
+    moe_top_k: int | None,
+    moe_intermediate_size: int | None,
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """``(category, maf_type, flops, bytes, output_elements)`` for a vLLM/SGLang
+    boundary shape_inference has no rule for, or ``None`` when *class_name*
+    names neither one (see the module docstring's approximations)."""
+    if any(marker in class_name for marker in _ENGINE_HEAD_CLASS_MARKERS):
+        return _engine_head_cost(dims, bpe)
+    if any(marker in class_name for marker in _ENGINE_MOE_CLASS_MARKERS):
+        return _moe_cost(dims, moe_top_k, moe_intermediate_size, bpe)
+    return None
+
+
+def _engine_head_cost(
+    dims: dict[str, Any], bpe: float | None
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """GEMM cost of the vocab projection a ``ParallelLMHead`` performs via its
+    pluggable ``quant_method`` (never its own ``forward``, which only raises)."""
+    try:
+        tokens = resolve_dim(dims["B"], dims) * resolve_dim(dims["S"], dims)
+        vocab = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.VOCAB.value], dims)
+        hidden = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.HIDDEN.value], dims)
+    except (KeyError, DimResolutionError):
+        return None
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(tokens, vocab, hidden, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(tokens, vocab, hidden, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved, tokens * vocab
+
+
+class _RuntimeIntrospection:
+    """Per-run values introspected from the ArchitectureSpec (config.json +
+    modeling source) so MoE / attention / quantization costs need no hardcoded
+    model names. Populated by :func:`project_roofline`."""
+
+    __slots__ = (
+        "weight_bpe",
+        "moe_top_k",
+        "moe_intermediate",
+        "moe_num_experts",
+        "ep",
+        "attn_heads",
+        "attn_kv_heads",
+        "attn_head_dim",
+        "sliding_window",
+        "n_local_layers",
+        "n_layers",
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.reset()
+
+    def reset(self):
+        self.weight_bpe = None
+        self.moe_top_k = None
+        self.moe_intermediate = None
+        self.moe_num_experts = None
+        self.ep = 1
+        self.attn_heads = None
+        self.attn_kv_heads = None
+        self.attn_head_dim = None
+        self.sliding_window = None
+        self.n_local_layers = None
+        self.n_layers = None
+
+
+_RT = _RuntimeIntrospection()
+
+
+def _introspect_weight_bpe(quant):
+    """Bytes/element of the quantized WEIGHT storage, from a HF
+    quantization_config. None when weights are unquantized."""
+    if not isinstance(quant, dict):
+        return None
+    try:
+        from TraceLens.ModelUtils.shape_inference import _quant_storage_dtype
+
+        wd = _quant_storage_dtype(quant)
+    except Exception:
+        wd = None
+    if not wd:
+        return None
+    w = wd.lower()
+    if "fp4" in w or "float4" in w or "mxfp4" in w or "e2m1" in w:
+        return 0.53125  # 4-bit element + 1-byte e8m0 scale per 32 (MXFP4)
+    if "fp8" in w or "float8" in w or "int8" in w:
+        return 1.0
+    if "int4" in w or "nf4" in w:
+        return 0.5
+    return None
+
+
+def _populate_introspection(spec):
+    _RT.reset()
+    cfg = getattr(spec, "raw_config", None) or {}
+    tcfg = cfg.get("text_config") if isinstance(cfg.get("text_config"), dict) else cfg
+    _RT.weight_bpe = _introspect_weight_bpe(cfg.get("quantization_config"))
+    _RT.moe_top_k = spec.num_experts_per_tok
+    _RT.moe_intermediate = spec.moe_intermediate_size or spec.intermediate_size
+    _RT.moe_num_experts = spec.num_experts
+    layout = getattr(spec, "parallel_layout", None)
+    _RT.ep = getattr(getattr(layout, "degree", None), "ep", 1) or 1
+    _RT.attn_heads = spec.num_attention_heads
+    _RT.attn_kv_heads = spec.num_key_value_heads or spec.num_attention_heads
+    if spec.head_dim:
+        _RT.attn_head_dim = spec.head_dim
+    elif spec.hidden_size and spec.num_attention_heads:
+        _RT.attn_head_dim = spec.hidden_size // spec.num_attention_heads
+    sw = tcfg.get("sliding_window_size") or tcfg.get("sliding_window")
+    _RT.sliding_window = sw if isinstance(sw, int) and sw > 0 else None
+    lli = tcfg.get("local_layer_ids")
+    _RT.n_local_layers = len(lli) if isinstance(lli, list) else None
+    _RT.n_layers = spec.num_hidden_layers
+
+
+def _attention_boundary_cost(dims, bpe):
+    """Roofline cost of ONE attention layer, introspected from the arch spec
+    (query/kv heads, head dim, sliding window, local/global layer mix). KV length
+    is averaged across the local (windowed) and global layers so the per-layer
+    cost times the layer-repeat count reproduces the true aggregate."""
+    if not (_RT.attn_heads and _RT.attn_head_dim):
+        return None
+    try:
+        b = resolve_dim(dims["B"], dims)
+        s = resolve_dim(dims["S"], dims)
+    except (KeyError, DimResolutionError):
+        return None
+    past = 0
+    for key in ("past_len", "past_length", "cache_len", "kv_len"):
+        if key in dims:
+            try:
+                past = resolve_dim(dims[key], dims)
+                break
+            except DimResolutionError:
+                pass
+    ctx = past + s
+    h_q = _RT.attn_heads
+    h_kv = _RT.attn_kv_heads or h_q
+    d_h = _RT.attn_head_dim
+    n_layers = _RT.n_layers or 1
+    if _RT.n_local_layers is not None:
+        n_local = _RT.n_local_layers
+    else:
+        n_local = n_layers if _RT.sliding_window else 0
+    n_global = max(n_layers - n_local, 0)
+    kv_local = min(ctx, _RT.sliding_window) if _RT.sliding_window else ctx
+    eff_n_kv = (n_local * kv_local + n_global * ctx) / n_layers if n_layers else ctx
+    causal = False  # decode / windowed cross-attention: N_Q != N_KV
+    flops = SDPA.flops_func(b, s, h_q, eff_n_kv, h_kv, d_h, d_h, causal)
+    bytes_moved = (
+        SDPA.bytes_func(b, s, h_q, eff_n_kv, h_kv, d_h, d_h, causal, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return "Attention", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+def _moe_cost(
+    dims: dict[str, Any],
+    top_k: int | None,
+    intermediate_size: int | None,
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """GroupedGEMM cost of the gate_up_proj + down_proj of the SELECTED experts,
+    plus the EP dispatch/combine all-to-all when expert-parallel.
+
+    ``top_k``/``intermediate_size`` come from the architecture's own MoE
+    config (``spec.num_experts_per_tok``, ``spec.moe_intermediate_size``), not
+    ``dims[Symbol.INTERMEDIATE]`` -- that key prefers a model's DENSE
+    ``intermediate_size`` (shared-expert / non-MoE layers) when both are
+    declared, which is the wrong width for the routed experts this costs.
+
+    The expert GEMMs are costed with :class:`GroupedGemm` over
+    ``G = min(num_experts, active_tokens)`` distinct expert weight matrices --
+    the weights actually streamed from HBM for this token count -- rather than a
+    single shared weight. FLOPs are unchanged (only the selected token-expert
+    pairs compute); the weight-byte term now scales with the experts touched, so
+    the memory-bound/compute-bound crossover tracks the real prefill-vs-decode
+    behaviour instead of understating decode weight traffic by ~``G``x. When
+    ``num_experts`` is unknown ``G`` falls back to 1 (the prior single-weight
+    cost).
+
+    When ``_RT.ep > 1`` the dispatch and combine all-to-all that move token
+    hidden states between expert-parallel ranks are added as pure data movement
+    (:class:`MoEComm`, FLOPs-free). This is the MoE op's own intrinsic
+    communication, distinct from the ``@comm:`` TP/PP collectives the projection
+    leaves to TreePerf.
+    """
+    if not top_k or not intermediate_size:
+        return None
+    try:
+        tokens = resolve_dim(dims["B"], dims) * resolve_dim(dims["S"], dims)
+        hidden = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.HIDDEN.value], dims)
+    except (KeyError, DimResolutionError):
+        return None
+    active_tokens = tokens * top_k
+    groups = min(_RT.moe_num_experts, active_tokens) if _RT.moe_num_experts else 1
+    wbpe = _RT.weight_bpe if _RT.weight_bpe is not None else bpe
+    # gate_up_proj: [active_tokens, hidden] x per-expert [hidden, 2*intermediate].
+    gate_up_flops = GroupedGemm.flops_func(active_tokens, hidden, 2 * intermediate_size)
+    # down_proj: [active_tokens, intermediate] x per-expert [intermediate, hidden].
+    down_flops = GroupedGemm.flops_func(active_tokens, intermediate_size, hidden)
+    flops = gate_up_flops + down_flops
+    bytes_moved: float | None = None
+    if bpe is not None:
+        gate_up_bytes = GroupedGemm.bytes_func(
+            active_tokens, hidden, 2 * intermediate_size, groups, wbpe, bpe
+        )
+        down_bytes = GroupedGemm.bytes_func(
+            active_tokens, intermediate_size, hidden, groups, wbpe, bpe
+        )
+        bytes_moved = gate_up_bytes + down_bytes
+        if _RT.ep > 1:
+            # Dispatch sends each token's hidden state to its top_k expert ranks;
+            # combine gathers the expert outputs back (MoEComm: num_tokens * hidden
+            # * bpe each). Token activations move at the activation dtype, not wbpe.
+            bytes_moved += 2 * active_tokens * hidden * bpe
+    return "MoE", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved, tokens * hidden
+
+
+def _split_shape_text(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str | None]:
+    """Split a drawn ``"[B, S, 4096] bfloat16"`` attr into (dims, dtype).
+
+    The dims list itself holds comma-separated, space-containing dims (``[B,
+    S, 4096]``), so the dtype suffix has to split on the closing bracket, not
+    on the first space.
+    """
+    stripped = text.strip()
+    if not stripped.startswith("["):
+        return parse_shape_dims(stripped), None
+    dims_part, bracket, dtype_part = stripped.partition("]")
+    return parse_shape_dims(dims_part + bracket), dtype_part.strip() or None
+
+
+def _dispatch_op_cost(
+    computation: str,
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+    details: str = "",
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    """Return ``(category, maf_type, flops, bytes)`` for an op, or ``None`` if unmodeled."""
+    if computation in _GEMM_NN_MODULE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _gemm_cost_linear(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if computation.lower() in _GEMM_FUNCTIONAL_LABELS:
+        return _gemm_cost_matmul(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if computation in _CONV_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _conv_cost(details, input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if computation == _SDPA_COMPUTATION:
+        return _sdpa_cost(input_shapes, bpe)
+    normalization_family = _classify_normalization(computation)
+    if normalization_family is not None:
+        kind, has_bias, channel_first = normalization_family
+        return _normalization_cost(
+            computation, kind, has_bias, channel_first, output_shape, bpe
+        )
+    if computation == _SOFTMAX_COMPUTATION:
+        return _softmax_cost(output_shape, bpe)
+    label = computation.lower()
+    if label in _REDUCTION_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _reduce_cost(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if label in _BINARY_POINTWISE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _binary_elementwise_cost(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if label in _UNARY_POINTWISE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _unary_elementwise_cost(output_shape, bpe)
+    return None
+
+
+def _gemm_cost_linear(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not input_shapes or not input_shapes[0] or not output_shape:
+        return None
+    input_shape = input_shapes[0]
+    k = input_shape[-1]
+    n = output_shape[-1]
+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(m, n, k, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(m, n, k, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+def _gemm_cost_matmul(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if len(input_shapes) < 2:
+        return None
+    a_shape, b_shape = input_shapes[0], input_shapes[1]
+    if not a_shape or not b_shape or not output_shape:
+        return None
+    k = a_shape[-1]
+    n = b_shape[-1]
+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(m, n, k, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(m, n, k, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+_CONV_WEIGHT_RE = re.compile(r"conv_weight=\[([0-9,\s]+)\]")
+_CONV_FLAG_RE = re.compile(r"conv_(bias|transposed)=([01])")
+
+
+def _parse_conv_details(details: str) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], bool, bool] | None:
+    """``(weight_shape, bias, transposed)`` from a node's ``details`` attr, or
+    ``None`` when the convolution geometry was not threaded onto the node.
+
+    The meta-device pass stamps ``conv_weight=[C_out, C_in/groups, *kernel]``,
+    ``conv_bias=0|1``, and ``conv_transposed=0|1`` (see ``meta_trace`` /
+    ``_CONV_COMPUTATIONS``)."""
+    if not details:
+        return None
+    match = _CONV_WEIGHT_RE.search(details)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    try:
+        weight = tuple(int(tok) for tok in match.group(1).split(",") if tok.strip())
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if not weight:
+        return None
+    flags = {k: v == "1" for k, v in _CONV_FLAG_RE.findall(details)}
+    return weight, flags.get("bias", False), flags.get("transposed", False)
+
+
+def _conv_cost(
+    details: str,
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    """CONV FLOPs/bytes from the input/output shapes plus the weight geometry on
+    the node's ``details`` attr. The strides/padding/dilation that `nn.Conv*`
+    uses only determine the output shape, which is already resolved here, so the
+    static ``CONV.flops_func``/``bytes_func`` need only the three shapes plus the
+    bias/transposed flags."""
+    parsed = _parse_conv_details(details)
+    if parsed is None or not input_shapes or not input_shapes[0] or not output_shape:
+        return None
+    weight_shape, bias, transposed = parsed
+    input_shape = input_shapes[0]
+    flops = CONV.flops_func(input_shape, weight_shape, output_shape, bias, transposed)
+    bytes_moved = (
+        CONV.bytes_func(input_shape, weight_shape, output_shape, bias, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return "CONV", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+def conv_ops_from_meta(
+    meta_convs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None,
+    *,
+    dtype: str = "bfloat16",
+    gpu_arch: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+) -> list[RooflineOp]:
+    """Roofline ops for every convolution a meta-device forward captured.
+
+    Each entry is one live ``_ConvNd`` instance from
+    :func:`TraceLens.ModelUtils.meta_trace.trace_meta_conv_ops`, carrying the
+    concrete ``[B, C, H, W]`` in/out shapes and weight geometry CONV needs. The
+    graph draws one conv per stage; each live instance here carries the geometry
+    to cost that instance, and the CLI uses these rows in place of the graph's
+    conv rows so the repeated stage is not counted twice."""
+    bpe = _BYTES_PER_ELEMENT.get(torch_dtype_map(dtype)) if dtype else None
+    ops: list[RooflineOp] = []
+    for conv in meta_convs or []:
+        out_shape = tuple(conv.get("output_shape") or ())
+        in_shape = tuple(conv["input_shape"]) if conv.get("input_shape") else None
+        weight_shape = tuple(conv.get("weight_shape") or ())
+        if not out_shape or in_shape is None or not weight_shape:
+            continue
+        path = str(conv.get("path") or "")
+        base = RooflineOp(
+            name=path,
+            section=path.split(".")[-1] or path,
+            computation="Conv",
+            operation="",
+            category=None,
+            modeled=False,
+            reason=None,
+            output_elements=prod(out_shape),
+            instances=1,
+        )
+        bias = bool(conv.get("bias"))
+        transposed = bool(conv.get("transposed"))
+        flops = CONV.flops_func(in_shape, weight_shape, out_shape, bias, transposed)
+        bytes_moved = (
+            CONV.bytes_func(in_shape, weight_shape, out_shape, bias, bpe)
+            if bpe is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        ops.append(
+            _finish_op(base, "CONV", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch)
+        )
+    return ops
+
+
+def _sdpa_cost(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if len(input_shapes) < 3:
+        return None
+    q_shape, k_shape, v_shape = input_shapes[0], input_shapes[1], input_shapes[2]
+    if not q_shape or not k_shape or not v_shape:
+        return None
+    if len(q_shape) < 4 or len(k_shape) < 4 or len(v_shape) < 4:
+        return None
+    # [B, heads, seq, head_dim], per the graph's own SDPA shape rule.
+    b, h_q, n_q, d_h_qk = q_shape[-4:]
+    _, h_kv, n_kv, _ = k_shape[-4:]
+    d_h_v = v_shape[-1]
+    causal = n_q == n_kv
+    flops = SDPA.flops_func(b, n_q, h_q, n_kv, h_kv, d_h_qk, d_h_v, causal)
+    bytes_moved = (
+        SDPA.bytes_func(b, n_q, h_q, n_kv, h_kv, d_h_qk, d_h_v, causal, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return "SDPA", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+def _normalization_cost(
+    computation: str,
+    kind: str,
+    has_bias: bool,
+    channel_first: bool,
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    num_elems = prod(output_shape)
+    if channel_first and len(output_shape) > 1:
+        num_channels = output_shape[1]
+    else:
+        num_channels = output_shape[-1]
+    if not num_channels:
+        return None
+    is_affine = True
+    if kind == "rmsnorm":
+        flops = _rmsnorm_flops(num_elems, num_channels, is_affine)
+        bytes_moved = (
+            _rmsnorm_bytes(num_elems, num_channels, is_affine, bpe, bpe)
+            if bpe is not None
+            else None
+        )
+    else:
+        flops = Normalization.flops_func(

+def _rmsnorm_flops(num_elems: int, num_channels: int, is_affine: bool) -> float:

+    flops_func exists there -- RMSNorm overrides the instance method directly)."""
+    non_normalized_elems = num_elems / num_channels

+    flops += num_elems * (2 if is_affine else 1)
+    return flops
+
+
+def _rmsnorm_bytes(
+    num_elems: int, num_channels: int, is_affine: bool, bpe_in: float, bpe_out: float
+) -> float:
+    """Mirrors RMSNorm.bytes() in TraceLens.PerfModel.perf_model."""
+    return (
+        num_elems * bpe_in
+        + num_elems * bpe_out
+        + (num_channels * bpe_in if is_affine else 0)
+    )

+def _softmax_cost(
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    n = output_shape[-1]
+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1
+    flops = Softmax.flops_func(m, n)

+
+
+def _unary_elementwise_cost(
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    nelems = prod(output_shape)
+    flops = UnaryElementwise.flops_func(nelems)
+    bytes_moved = (
+        UnaryElementwise.bytes_func(nelems, bpe, bpe) if bpe is not None else None
+    )

+
+
+def _binary_elementwise_cost(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    nelems_out = prod(output_shape)

+    # carry its own shape; one element is the honest size for such an operand.
+    shape1 = input_shapes[0] if input_shapes else None

+    nelems_in2 = prod(shape2) if shape2 else 1

+    bytes_moved = (
+        BinaryElementwise.bytes_func(nelems_in1, nelems_in2, nelems_out, bpe, bpe, bpe)

+        else None
+    )
+    return "BinaryElementwise", "vector", flops, bytes_moved

+def _reduce_cost(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not input_shapes or not input_shapes[0]:
+        return None
+    input_shape = input_shapes[0]
+    num_input_elems = prod(input_shape)
+    num_output_elems = prod(output_shape) if output_shape else 1

+    bytes_moved = (
+        Reduce.bytes_func(num_input_elems, num_output_elems, bpe, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )

+# Project a model's roofline from its checkpoint alone
+```{meta}
+:description: Project a kernel-by-kernel roofline for a whole model from its checkpoint config and modeling source, with no trace or GPU run.
+:keywords: TraceLens, roofline, FLOPS, GEMM, SDPA, Normalization, static analysis, sizing study, no trace, ROCm, MI300X
+```
+
+`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection` builds the same merged Model Explorer
+graph as `TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` (statically parsing
+`modeling_*.py` instead of executing any model code), maps every op with a
+direct [`TraceLens.PerfModel`](./perf-model-without-trace.md) formula to its
+FLOPs/bytes, and prints a kernel-by-kernel roofline table plus a model-level
+rollup — no trace and no GPU run required. Reusing the same graph means a
+`--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` split draws, and costs, the exact per-GPU local shapes the
+viewer would show for that split, not a second, independently-matched
+approximation of it.
+
+## Before you begin
+
+Confirm you have the following before continuing.
+
+- [TraceLens installed](../install/install.md).
+- A Hugging Face model id or local checkpoint directory with a `config.json`
+  and `modeling_*.py` (see `--github` below for checkpoints that don't ship
+  their own modeling source).
+
+## Run the tool
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_model_roofline_projection meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B \
+    --batch-size 1 --seq-len 4096 \
+    --gpu-arch-name MI300X
+```
+
+This prints a table ranked by projected roofline time, one row per op in a
+representative decoder layer (each annotated with that op's own repeat count —
+the merged graph's own tile count for the structural variant it sits in, so a
+hybrid layer mix like MoE-every-few-layers is already attributed per-variant,
+not spread evenly across every layer), plus ops outside the repeated layer
+stack (embedding, LM head) at their own single-instance cost. A rollup line
+reports total FLOPs/bytes, the compute-bound vs. memory-bound time split, and
+what fraction of the model's output elements were actually modeled.
+
+## Projecting one GPU's share of a sharded deployment
+
+Add `--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` to project one GPU's own share of the work under a
+tensor-/pipeline-/expert-parallel split, the same split
+`TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` draws:
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_model_roofline_projection MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    --engine vllm --tp 2 --ep 4 \
+    --batch-size 1 --seq-len 2048 \
+    --gpu-arch-name MI325X
+```
+
+The split itself comes from the checkpoint's declared `base_model_tp_plan`/
+`base_model_pp_plan`/`base_model_ep_plan` (Hugging Face), or, with `--engine
+vllm`/`--engine sglang`, from that inference engine's own parallel-layer
+classes (`ColumnParallelLinear`, `RowParallelLinear`, `QKVParallelLinear`, a
+`FusedMoE`'s expert count, ...) — including a model-specific subclass of one of
+these. Each GEMM is costed at its per-GPU local shape (a column-sharded
+projection's output divided by the TP count, an expert stack's expert count
+divided by the EP count, ...), derived by re-running the real shape-inference
+engine against a locally-divided config, not by guessing which axis a shape
+text happens to match. `1` on any of `--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` leaves that axis
+unsplit (the default: a single, unsharded GPU).
+
+Without `--gpu-arch-name`/`--gpu-arch-json-path`, FLOPs and bytes are still
+reported but no roofline time is computed (no hardware peaks to bound against).
+
+## Flags
+
+- `--batch-size`, `--seq-len`: the shape to project at (default: 1, 2048).
+- `--dim KEY=VALUE` (repeatable): override a specific symbolic dimension
+  (e.g. `--dim past_len=1024`); takes precedence over `--batch-size`/`--seq-len`
+  for the same key.
+- `--gpu-arch-name NAME`: a bundled GPU arch spec (`MI300X`, `MI325X`, ...).
+- `--gpu-arch-json-path PATH`: a custom GPU arch JSON (same schema).
+- `--output-csv PATH` / `--output-json PATH`: write the full per-op table (JSON
+  also includes the rollup).
+- `--top-n N`: rows printed to stdout (default: 20; `0` for all).
+
+## Model source and runtime regime flags
+
+The checkpoint-provenance flags (`--github`, `--config-path`, `--code-path`,
+`--basic-op-add`/`--basic-op-remove`, `--meta-shapes`/`--no-meta-shapes`), the
+runtime-regime flags (`--phase`, `--cache`, `--sequence-layout`, `--attention`,
+`--mode`, `--device`, `--config-override`), and the device-partition flags
+(`--engine`, `--tp`, `--pp`, `--ep`) are the same ones
+`TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` supports, since both tools build the
+checkpoint's graph through the same backend — run
+`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection --help` for the full list.
+
+Unlike the Model Explorer export, this tool always stops AST expansion exactly
+at ops with a direct `TraceLens.PerfModel` formula (`Linear`, the Normalization
+family, `Softmax`, ...) rather than expanding into their internal primitive
+steps — there is no `--stop-at-roofline-ops` flag here because turning it off
+would only replace a correctly-costed op with several the projection has no
+formula for.
+
+## Op coverage and approximations
+
+Costed op families: GEMM (`Linear`/`matmul`/`bmm`, including a vLLM/SGLang
+`*ParallelLinear`/`ReplicatedLinear` class or a model-specific subclass of
+one), SDPA, the Normalization family (RMSNorm, LayerNorm, GroupNorm,
+BatchNorm, InstanceNorm — matched by subclass name, since real checkpoints
+almost always subclass these), Softmax, generic elementwise/reduction ops, and
+MoE expert routing. A vLLM/SGLang `ParallelLMHead`/`FusedMoE` boundary — read
+from the engine's own source, where shape_inference has no rule for either —
+is costed from the architecture's own dims (vocab, hidden,
+experts-per-token, expert intermediate size) instead of its node shape; see
+"Known approximations" below. Everything else — embeddings, convolutions,
+reshapes/transposes — is reported as **unmodeled** rather than silently
+dropped, so the rollup's coverage share tells you how much of the model the
+projection actually accounts for.
+
+Known approximations:
+
+- GEMM bias is assumed absent.
+- Every Normalization op is assumed affine; RMSNorm is assumed bias-free, every
+  other norm is assumed to have one.
+- SDPA is assumed causal exactly when the query and key/value sequence lengths
+  resolve equal (a self-attention prefill shape).
+- MoE routing is costed as `experts_per_tok` GEMM passes per token (the
+  gate_up_proj and down_proj of only the selected experts), never
+  `num_experts` passes. The router's own softmax/top-k selection and any
+  shared-expert add are not separately costed.
+
+## Run from a chat
+
+A portable skill drives this CLI for agentic runners that support skill-file
+discovery (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). In a chat with a capable model,
+invoke:
+
+```text
+Follow the model roofline projection skill installed with TraceLens and
+project <model> at batch size <N> and sequence length <N> on <GPU arch>.
+```
+
+See [TraceLens/Agent/Visualizer/skills/model-roofline-projection/](../../TraceLens/Agent/Visualizer/skills/model-roofline-projection/SKILL.md)
+for the skill's full procedure.
+

+

+- [GEMM analysis in TraceLens](../conceptual/gemm-analysis.md)
+- [API reference](../reference/api-reference.md)

+# Visualize a model with the TraceLens Agent
+```{meta}
+:description: Learn how to run the TraceLens model visualizer agent, which exports a Hugging Face checkpoint to a standalone Model Explorer architecture graph.
+:keywords: TraceLens, model visualizer, Model Explorer, Hugging Face, architecture graph, tensor parallelism, agent
+```
+
+This topic shows how to run the *model visualizer* agent. The agent exports a
+Hugging Face checkpoint, a local checkpoint directory, or a whitelisted modeling
+repo to an interactive Model Explorer graph. The export parses the model's
+`modeling_*.py` source and fills symbolic tensor shapes. It runs on CPU and
+does not load checkpoint weights.
+
+## Before you begin
+
+- TraceLens with the Visualizer extra. See [Install TraceLens](../install/install.md).
+- A Hugging Face model id, a local checkpoint directory, or an allowlisted modeling repo.
+- `HF_TOKEN`, when the checkpoint is gated.
+- Network access the first time a Hub model is fetched. No GPU is required.
+
+## Run the agent from a chat
+
+```{note}
+The skill is portable and works with agentic runners that support skill-file
+discovery (for example, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex).
+```
+
+In a chat with a capable model, invoke:
+
+```text
+Follow the model visualizer installed with TraceLens and export <model> to <path>.html
+```
+
+`<model>` is a Hugging Face id or a local checkpoint directory. If prompted,
+provide the output path, whether you want a live viewer instead of a file, the
+runtime regime (packed sequences, decode, warm cache, training), the attention
+implementation (`eager`, `sdpa`, `flash_attention_2`, or another name; omit it
+to keep the checkpoint's), any `KEY=VALUE` config overrides, and the sharding
+source plus counts. Hugging Face plans are the default. Name vLLM or SGLang
+when the drawing should follow that engine, and give `--tp`, `--pp`, and
+`--ep` for the axes you care about.
+
+### Headless run
+
+Any agent CLI that can discover the installed skill can run the export without
+prompts. Pass the model and the output path in the prompt:
+
+```bash
+agent --model claude-opus-4-8-thinking-medium --print --force --trust \
+    "Follow the model visualizer installed with the TraceLens pip package (look under TraceLens/Agent/Visualizer/skills/model-visualizer/ in the package installation directory) and export <model> to <path>.html"
+```
+
+## Read the results
+
+The file you open is `<path>.html`. It embeds the graph payload, the TraceLens
+viewer, and the layout worker. The `<model-explorer-visualizer>` element and
+its font textures load from unpkg the first time you open the file.
+
+| Request | Artifact |
+| --- | --- |
+| Default export | one `.html` file |
+| `--tp`, `--pp`, or `--ep` with more than one GPU group | `<stem>_subgraph_<i>.html` |
+| `-o model.json` | Model Explorer payload; render it later with `--from-payload` |
+| `--operators-json` | flat operator list with inferred shapes |
+| `--serve` | local viewer at `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` (the process stays running) |
+
+Shapes use the symbols `B` (batch), `S` (sequence), `H` (hidden), and the
+attention, expert, and vocabulary symbols documented in the Visualizer README.
+By default, the model renders a non-cached rectangular prefill in inference
+mode. Attention follows the checkpoint. `--device hip` draws the HIP branches
+in the modeling source. It does not choose the machine that runs the export.
+
+## What the agent runs
+
+The agent runs a single `visualize_model_in_explorer` command after confirming
+the Visualizer extra imports. It checks that an HTML file contains
+`model-explorer-visualizer` or that a JSON payload contains `graphCollections`,
+then reports the absolute path.

++"""Torch profiler helpers for CUDA/HIP graph capture tracing.
++
++Graph capture is driven by three subsystems (encoder, decoder and speculator)
++that reach the same handful of capture loops by different routes.
++``graph_capture_profiler`` binds one profiler around a subsystem's capture,
++and ``graph_capture_step`` picks that binding up inside whichever capture loop
++ends up running. Capture loops therefore carry no profiler plumbing, and a new
++speculator built on an existing capture loop is traced without further changes.
++"""
++
++from __future__ import annotations
++
++import contextvars
++from collections.abc import Iterator
++from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, contextmanager, nullcontext
++from dataclasses import dataclass
++from typing import Any
++
++import torch

++from vllm.config import VllmConfig
++from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
++from vllm.logger import init_logger
++
++logger = init_logger(__name__)
++
++
++@dataclass(frozen=True)
++class _CaptureBinding:
++    profiler: AbstractContextManager[Any]
++    label_prefix: str | None
++
++
++_active_binding: contextvars.ContextVar[_CaptureBinding | None] = (
++    contextvars.ContextVar("vllm_graph_capture_binding", default=None)
++)
++
++
++def _make_profiler(
++    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
++    subsystem: str | None,
++) -> AbstractContextManager[Any]:
++    profiler_config = vllm_config.profiler_config
++    local_rank = get_world_group().local_rank
++    if local_rank != 0 or not profiler_config.capture_torch_profiler:
++        logger.info_once(
++            "Rank %d: Torch profiler disabled for CUDA graph capture", local_rank
++        )
++        return nullcontext()
++
++    trace_dir = profiler_config.torch_profiler_dir + "/capture_traces"
++    worker_name = f"graph_capture_rank_{local_rank}"
++    if subsystem:
++        worker_name += f"_{subsystem}"
++    logger.info_once(
++        "Rank %d: Torch profiler enabled for %s CUDA graph capture, "
++        "traces will be saved to: %s",
++        local_rank,
++        subsystem or "decoder",
++        trace_dir,
++    )
++    return torch.profiler.profile(
++        activities=[
++            torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU,
++            torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA,
++        ],
++        record_shapes=True,
++        profile_memory=True,
++        with_stack=True,
++        on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler(
++            trace_dir,
++            worker_name=worker_name,
++            use_gzip=True,
++        ),
++    )
++
++
++@contextmanager
++def graph_capture_profiler(
++    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
++    subsystem: str | None = None,
++    label_prefix: str | None = None,
++) -> Iterator[None]:
++    """Bind a graph-capture profiler for one subsystem's capture.
++
++    Args:
++        subsystem: Suffix for the trace file name. ``"encoder"`` writes
++            ``graph_capture_rank_0_encoder.<timestamp>.pt.trace.json.gz``;
++            the main decoder passes ``None`` and keeps the unsuffixed name.
++        label_prefix: Inserted into every annotation recorded inside the
++            block, so that e.g. speculator graphs are labelled
++            ``capture_32_draft_FULL`` rather than reusing the decoder's
++            ``capture_32_FULL``.
++    """
++    binding = _CaptureBinding(
++        profiler=_make_profiler(vllm_config, subsystem),
++        label_prefix=label_prefix,
++    )
++    token = _active_binding.set(binding)
++    try:
++        yield
++    finally:
++        _active_binding.reset(token)
++
++
++@contextmanager
++def graph_capture_step(num_tokens: int, mode: str) -> Iterator[None]:
++    """Profile the capture of a single graph shape.
++
++    Records a ``capture_{num_tokens}_{mode}`` annotation, or
++    ``capture_{num_tokens}_{label_prefix}_{mode}`` when the active binding
++    sets a prefix. Does nothing outside a ``graph_capture_profiler`` block, so
++    capture loops can call this unconditionally.
++    """
++    binding = _active_binding.get()
++    if binding is None:
++        yield
++        return
++
++    if binding.label_prefix:
++        label = f"capture_{num_tokens}_{binding.label_prefix}_{mode}"
++    else:
++        label = f"capture_{num_tokens}_{mode}"
++    with binding.profiler, torch.profiler.record_function(label):
++        yield

+###############################################################################

+"""A model's repeated structure is not always one uniform stack.
+
+ConvNeXt is four stages (``depths=[3,3,27,3]``) of a shared ``ConvNextLayer`` at
+growing channel widths -- a NON-uniform nesting the single-decoder-stack model
+cannot express. These tests pin the reconstruction of that nesting from the flat
+live ``MetaModuleGroup`` list, and the conservative predicate that decides when a
+model is non-uniform, WITHOUT instantiating anything: the tree is rebuilt from
+dotted paths alone, and the predicate must never misread a uniform (even MoE)
+transformer as non-uniform.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import types
+
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract import (
+    ArchitectureSpec,
+    _build_nested_groups,
+    _is_non_uniform,
+    ordered_repeated_children,
+    reconcile_live_module_groups,
+    repeated_group_is_pipeline,
+)
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.meta_trace import MetaModuleGroup
+
+
+def _grp(
+    path: str,
+    length: int,
+    element_class: str,
+    element_classes: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+) -> MetaModuleGroup:
+    return MetaModuleGroup(
+        path=path,
+        length=length,
+        element_class=element_class,
+        signatures=(),
+        element_classes=element_classes,
+    )
+
+
+# What walk_meta_module_tree reports for facebook/convnext-base-224-22k.
+CONVNEXT_GROUPS = [
+    _grp("convnext.encoder.stages", 4, "ConvNextStage"),
+    _grp("convnext.encoder.stages.0.layers", 3, "ConvNextLayer"),
+    _grp("convnext.encoder.stages.1.layers", 3, "ConvNextLayer"),
+    _grp("convnext.encoder.stages.2.layers", 27, "ConvNextLayer"),
+    _grp("convnext.encoder.stages.3.layers", 3, "ConvNextLayer"),
+    _grp(
+        "convnext.encoder.stages.1.downsampling_layer",
+        2,
+        "ConvNextLayerNorm",
+        ("ConvNextLayerNorm", "Conv2d"),
+    ),
+    _grp(
+        "convnext.encoder.stages.2.downsampling_layer",
+        2,
+        "ConvNextLayerNorm",
+        ("ConvNextLayerNorm", "Conv2d"),
+    ),
+    _grp(
+        "convnext.encoder.stages.3.downsampling_layer",
+        2,
+        "ConvNextLayerNorm",
+        ("ConvNextLayerNorm", "Conv2d"),
+    ),
+]
+
+
+# ResNet-50: four stages whose depths live in a Sequential, not a ModuleList.
+# depths [3, 4, 6, 3] — the second non-uniform model the ConvNeXt path has to cover.
+RESNET_GROUPS = [
+    _grp("resnet.encoder.stages", 4, "ResNetStage"),
+    _grp("resnet.encoder.stages.0.layers", 3, "ResNetBottleNeckLayer"),
+    _grp("resnet.encoder.stages.1.layers", 4, "ResNetBottleNeckLayer"),
+    _grp("resnet.encoder.stages.2.layers", 6, "ResNetBottleNeckLayer"),
+    _grp("resnet.encoder.stages.3.layers", 3, "ResNetBottleNeckLayer"),
+]
+
+
+def test_build_nested_groups_reconstructs_the_convnext_tree():
+    roots = _build_nested_groups(CONVNEXT_GROUPS)
+    # One root: the 4-stage container.
+    assert len(roots) == 1
+    stages = roots[0]
+    assert stages.path == "convnext.encoder.stages"
+    assert stages.count == 4
+    assert stages.element_class == "ConvNextStage"
+
+    children = {child.path: child for child in stages.children}
+    # The four per-stage `layers` lists fold into ONE collapsed child, carrying each
+    # stage's own depth in per_index_counts.
+    layers = children["convnext.encoder.stages.*.layers"]
+    assert layers.element_class == "ConvNextLayer"
+    assert layers.per_index_counts == [3, 3, 27, 3]
+    # The downsampling list is absent from stage 0 -> leading 0, sized to the parent's
+    # own repeat count (4).
+    downs = children["convnext.encoder.stages.*.downsampling_layer"]
+    assert downs.per_index_counts == [0, 2, 2, 2]
+    # The list is LayerNorm then Conv2d, not 2× the first class.
+    assert downs.element_classes == ("ConvNextLayerNorm", "Conv2d")
+    assert repeated_group_is_pipeline(downs) is True
+    assert repeated_group_is_pipeline(layers) is False
+
+
+def test_is_non_uniform_fires_for_convnext():
+    assert _is_non_uniform(_build_nested_groups(CONVNEXT_GROUPS)) is True
+
+
+def test_resnet_stage_depths_are_a_second_non_uniform_tree():
+    roots = _build_nested_groups(RESNET_GROUPS)
+    assert _is_non_uniform(roots) is True
+    layers = roots[0].children[0]
+    assert layers.path == "resnet.encoder.stages.*.layers"
+    assert layers.element_class == "ResNetBottleNeckLayer"
+    assert layers.per_index_counts == [3, 4, 6, 3]
+
+
+def test_downsampling_pipeline_leads_the_repeated_body_without_a_forward():
+    stages = _build_nested_groups(CONVNEXT_GROUPS)[0]
+    # Discovery order is layers then downsample; the pipeline still leads.
+    ordered = ordered_repeated_children(
+        ArchitectureSpec(name="c", model_type="c"), stages
+    )
+    assert [child.path.split(".")[-1] for child in ordered] == [
+        "downsampling_layer",
+        "layers",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_forward_calls_override_the_pipeline_first_heuristic():
+    stages = _build_nested_groups(CONVNEXT_GROUPS)[0]
+    spec = ArchitectureSpec(name="c", model_type="c")
+    spec.class_registry = {
+        "ConvNextStage": types.SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_calls=["layers", "downsampling_layer"]
+        )
+    }
+    ordered = ordered_repeated_children(spec, stages)
+    assert [child.path.split(".")[-1] for child in ordered] == [
+        "layers",
+        "downsampling_layer",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_is_non_uniform_ignores_a_uniform_llm():
+    # A plain decoder stack: one ModuleList, no nesting.
+    groups = [_grp("model.layers", 32, "LlamaDecoderLayer")]
+    nested = _build_nested_groups(groups)
+    assert len(nested) == 1 and nested[0].per_index_counts is None
+    assert _is_non_uniform(nested) is False
+
+
+def test_is_non_uniform_ignores_a_uniform_moe_stack():
+    # Every layer owns an identical 256-expert ModuleList -> uniform per-position count.
+    groups = [_grp("model.layers", 32, "DecoderLayer")] + [
+        _grp(f"model.layers.{i}.mlp.experts", 256, "Expert") for i in range(32)
+    ]
+    assert _is_non_uniform(_build_nested_groups(groups)) is False
+
+
+def test_is_non_uniform_ignores_dense_replace_moe():
+    # Experts absent in the first two (dense) layers, identical where present:
+    # per_index_counts = [0, 0, 256, ...] -> non-zero counts all equal -> uniform.

+"""End-to-end: a convolutional model's encoder becomes real graph nodes.
+
+ConvNeXt is four non-uniform stages (``depths=[3,3,27,3]``, channels
+``[128,256,512,1024]``) the single uniform decoder stack cannot express, so its
+convolutions used to never render. This pins that the reconstructed nested-group
+path emits them: one labeled ``N× ConvNextLayer`` container per stage, the stem
+and each later stage's downsampling conv as leading nodes, and each conv sized
+with the concrete per-stage ``[B, C, H, W]`` a meta forward captures. Skips when
+the checkpoint or torch is unavailable (offline CI).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+pytest.importorskip("torch")
+pytest.importorskip("transformers")
+
+from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.ast_build import (  # noqa: E402
+    build_model_explorer_payload,
+)
+from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.roofline_cli import (  # noqa: E402
+    build_parser,
+    load_architecture_spec_from_args,
+)
+
+CHECKPOINT = "facebook/convnext-base-224-22k"
+
+
+def _attr(node, key):
+    for item in node.get("attrs") or []:
+        if item.get("key") == key:
+            return item.get("value")
+    return None
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def convnext_export():
+    # Use the roofline/export loader (leaf-op basic_ops) -- the real path this
+    # feature serves.
+    try:
+        args = build_parser().parse_args([CHECKPOINT])
+        spec = load_architecture_spec_from_args(CHECKPOINT, args)
+        payload = build_model_explorer_payload(
+            spec, include_shapes=True, meta_shapes_checkpoint=CHECKPOINT
+        )
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        pytest.skip(f"ConvNeXt graph unavailable (offline / no torch): {exc}")
+    if not spec.nested_module_groups:
+        pytest.skip("meta module tree unavailable (instantiation failed)")
+    graph = payload["graphCollections"][0]["graphs"][0]
+    return spec, payload, graph
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def convnext_nodes(convnext_export):
+    return convnext_export[2]["nodes"]
+
+
+_CONV_OP_TYPES = {"Conv1d", "Conv2d", "Conv3d"}
+
+
+def _conv_nodes(nodes):
+    return [n for n in nodes if _attr(n, "op_type") in _CONV_OP_TYPES]
+
+
+def test_every_stage_renders_an_n_times_convnextlayer_container(convnext_nodes):
+    namespaces = {n.get("namespace", "") for n in convnext_nodes}
+    # The four stages' depths [3,3,27,3] become distinct per-stage containers.
+    for stage, count in enumerate([3, 3, 27, 3]):
+        assert any(
+            f"s{stage}_{count}x_ConvNextLayer" in ns for ns in namespaces
+        ), f"missing stage {stage} ({count}x ConvNextLayer) container"
+
+
+def test_stage_containers_are_labeled_and_the_fact_sheet_lists_them(convnext_export):
+    _spec, payload, graph = convnext_export
+    labels = {
+        attrs.get("label")
+        for attrs in graph["groupNodeAttributes"].values()
+        if isinstance(attrs, dict)
+    }
+    for stage, count in enumerate([3, 3, 27, 3]):
+        assert f"stage {stage} · {count}× ConvNextLayer" in labels
+    body = payload["tracelensViewer"]["factSheet"]["body"]
+    assert "Stages: 4× ConvNextStage" in body
+    assert "stage 0: 3× ConvNextLayer" in body
+    assert "stage 2: ConvNextLayerNorm → Conv2d, 27× ConvNextLayer" in body
+
+
+def test_convolutions_carry_concrete_per_stage_spatial_shapes(convnext_nodes):
+    # Stem + one downsample conv on stages 1..3 + one dwconv per stage.
+    convs = _conv_nodes(convnext_nodes)
+    shapes = {n.get("id"): _attr(n, "output_shape") for n in convs}
+    assert len(shapes) == 8
+    # Stem patch-embed leads the encoder: [B,3,224,224] -> [B,128,56,56].
+    stem = next(v for k, v in shapes.items() if "embeddings" in k)
+    assert stem.startswith("[B, 128, 56, 56]")
+    expected = {
+        "s0_3x_ConvNextLayer": "[B, 128, 56, 56]",
+        "s1_3x_ConvNextLayer": "[B, 256, 28, 28]",
+        "s2_27x_ConvNextLayer": "[B, 512, 14, 14]",
+        "s3_3x_ConvNextLayer": "[B, 1024, 7, 7]",
+    }
+    for slug, prefix in expected.items():
+        value = next(
+            v for k, v in shapes.items() if slug in k and "downsampling" not in k
+        )
+        assert value.startswith(prefix), f"{slug}: {value!r} != {prefix}"
+    # Downsample convs lead stages 1..3 and halve the spatial dims into that stage.
+    downsample = {
+        "s1_": "[B, 256, 28, 28]",
+        "s2_": "[B, 512, 14, 14]",
+        "s3_": "[B, 1024, 7, 7]",
+    }
+    for slug, prefix in downsample.items():
+        value = next(
+            v
+            for k, v in shapes.items()
+            if slug in k and "downsampling" in k and "Conv2d" in k
+        )
+        assert value.startswith(prefix), f"downsample {slug}: {value!r} != {prefix}"
+    # The conv's own boundary used to stay on the text-model shape.
+    boundary = next(
+        node
+        for node in convnext_nodes
+        if "s1_downsampling_layer_1_Conv2d" in (node.get("id") or "")
+        and _attr(node, "synthetic") == "@output"
+    )
+    assert _attr(boundary, "output_shape").startswith("[B, 256, 28, 28]")

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Per-stage labels and leading downsampling nodes, without a checkpoint.
+
+The live ConvNeXt / ResNet graphs are covered separately and skip offline. This
+pins the emission itself: each stage container is labeled with its index, and a
+mixed-class downsample list is drawn element-by-element ahead of that stage's
+repeated body rather than as N× its first class.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.basic_ops import BasicOpFilter
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.blocks import RepeatedGroup
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract import ArchitectureSpec
+from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.merge import (
+    _append_nested_repeated_group,
+)
+
+
+def _convnext_stages() -> RepeatedGroup:
+    # Children are in discovery order (layers first). Emission must still lead
+    # with the downsample pipeline.
+    return RepeatedGroup(
+        path="convnext.encoder.stages",
+        count=4,
+        element_class="ConvNextStage",
+        label="",
+        children=[
+            RepeatedGroup(
+                path="convnext.encoder.stages.*.layers",
+                count=3,
+                element_class="ConvNextLayer",
+                label="",
+                per_index_counts=[3, 3, 27, 3],
+            ),
+            RepeatedGroup(
+                path="convnext.encoder.stages.*.downsampling_layer",
+                count=2,
+                element_class="ConvNextLayerNorm",
+                label="",
+                element_classes=("ConvNextLayerNorm", "Conv2d"),
+                per_index_counts=[0, 2, 2, 2],
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def test_stages_are_labeled_and_downsampling_convs_lead_them():
+    nodes: list[dict] = []
+    attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
+    _append_nested_repeated_group(
+        nodes,
+        spec=ArchitectureSpec(name="convnext", model_type="convnext"),
+        group=_convnext_stages(),
+        namespace_prefix="encoder",
+        id_prefix="encoder",
+        basic_ops=BasicOpFilter.for_roofline(),
+        previous_exits=["@input"],
+        group_node_configs=[],
+        group_node_attributes=attributes,
+        shape_inferencer=None,
+        inline_expansion=True,
+    )
+
+    labels = {attrs["label"] for attrs in attributes.values()}
+    assert labels == {
+        "stage 0 · 3× ConvNextLayer",
+        "stage 1 · 3× ConvNextLayer",
+        "stage 2 · 27× ConvNextLayer",
+        "stage 3 · 3× ConvNextLayer",
+    }
+    # Stage 0 has an empty downsample list: no leading conv.
+    assert not any("s0_" in node["id"] and "Conv2d" in node["id"] for node in nodes)
+
+    def _id(fragment: str) -> str:
+        return next(node["id"] for node in nodes if fragment in node["id"])
+
+    conv = _id("s1_downsampling_layer_1_Conv2d")
+    norm = _id("s1_downsampling_layer_0_ConvNextLayerNorm")
+    # The conv is the ModuleList's second element, so its meta path ends in .1.
+    conv_node = next(node for node in nodes if node["id"] == conv)
+    meta = {
+        item["key"]: item["value"]
+        for item in conv_node.get("attrs") or []
+        if item.get("key") in {"meta_path", "class_name"}
+    }
+    assert meta["class_name"] == "Conv2d"
+    assert meta["meta_path"].endswith("stages.1.downsampling_layer.1")
+    assert conv_node["label"] == "stage 1 · Conv2d"
+
+    # Norm then conv lead the stage, and the conv feeds the stage's N× body.
+    body_input = _id("s1_3x_ConvNextLayer/@input")
+    sources = [
+        edge["sourceNodeId"]
+        for edge in next(node for node in nodes if node["id"] == body_input)[
+            "incomingEdges"
+        ]
+    ]
+    assert sources == [conv]
+    norm_node = next(node for node in nodes if node["id"] == norm)
+    assert [edge["sourceNodeId"] for edge in conv_node["incomingEdges"]] == [norm]
+    assert norm_node["label"] == "stage 1 · ConvNextLayerNorm"
+
+
+def test_stage_namespace_counts_as_its_depth_and_a_shortcut_once():
+    from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.roofline_projection import (
+        _repeat_count,
+    )
+
+    assert _repeat_count("encoder/s2_27x_ConvNextLayer/dwconv") == 27
+    assert _repeat_count("45x_DecoderLayer/attn") == 45
+    shortcut = {"attrs": [{"key": "repeat_count", "value": "1"}]}
+    assert _repeat_count("encoder/s0_3x_ResNetBottleNeckLayer/shortcut", shortcut) == 1
+
+
+def test_a_sequential_body_expands_into_the_live_children():
+    import ast
+
+    from TraceLens.ModelUtils.ast_analyze import ClassStructure
+    from TraceLens.ModelUtils.block_tree import build_block_node
+
+    def cls(name, calls, assignments):
+        return ClassStructure(
+            name=name,
+            node=ast.parse(f"class {name}:\n    pass").body[0],
+            init_assignments=assignments,
+            init_details={},
+            forward_calls=calls,
+            norm_before=[],
+        )
+
+    tree = build_block_node(
+        attr_name="Bottle",
+        class_name="Bottle",
+        registry={
+            "Bottle": cls("Bottle", ["layer"], {"layer": "Sequential"}),
+            "Conv2d": cls("Conv2d", [], {}),
+        },
+        basic_ops=BasicOpFilter.for_roofline(),
+        infer_init_steps=True,
+        class_overrides={"layer.0": "Conv2d", "layer.1": "Conv2d", "layer.2": "Conv2d"},
+    )
+    convs = [child for child in tree.children if child.class_name == "Conv2d"]
+    assert [child.attr_name for child in convs] == ["layer.0", "layer.1", "layer.2"]

+###############################################################################

+#

+###############################################################################
+
+"""ResNet-50 is the second non-uniform model: stage depths live in Sequentials.
+
+``depths=[3,4,6,3]`` cannot be one uniform stack. Unlike ConvNeXt, the repeated
+body is an ``nn.Sequential``, not a ``ModuleList``. Skips when the checkpoint or
+torch is unavailable (offline CI).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+pytest.importorskip("torch")
+pytest.importorskip("transformers")
+
+from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.ast_build import (  # noqa: E402
+    build_model_explorer_payload,
+)
+from TraceLens.Visualizer.model_explorer_export.roofline_cli import (  # noqa: E402
+    build_parser,
+    load_architecture_spec_from_args,
+)
+
+CHECKPOINT = "microsoft/resnet-50"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def resnet_export():
+    try:
+        args = build_parser().parse_args([CHECKPOINT])
+        spec = load_architecture_spec_from_args(CHECKPOINT, args)
+        payload = build_model_explorer_payload(
+            spec, include_shapes=True, meta_shapes_checkpoint=CHECKPOINT
+        )
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        pytest.skip(f"ResNet graph unavailable (offline / no torch): {exc}")
+    if not spec.nested_module_groups:
+        pytest.skip("meta module tree unavailable (instantiation failed)")
+    graph = payload["graphCollections"][0]["graphs"][0]
+    return payload, graph
+
+
+def test_resnet50_stages_render_with_per_stage_labels(resnet_export):
+    payload, graph = resnet_export
+    labels = {
+        attrs.get("label")
+        for attrs in graph["groupNodeAttributes"].values()
+        if isinstance(attrs, dict)
+    }
+    for stage, count in enumerate([3, 4, 6, 3]):
+        assert f"stage {stage} · {count}× ResNetBottleNeckLayer" in labels
+        assert any(
+            f"s{stage}_{count}x_ResNetBottleNeckLayer" in (node.get("namespace") or "")
+            for node in graph["nodes"]
+        )
+    body = payload["tracelensViewer"]["factSheet"]["body"]
+    assert "Stages: 4× ResNetStage" in body
+    assert "stage 2: 6× ResNetBottleNeckLayer" in body
+    # The stem convolution leads the encoder, and each bottleneck's three convs
+    # are nodes — not one opaque Sequential. The stem's shape is spatial.
+    convs = []
+    for node in graph["nodes"]:
+        attrs = {
+            item.get("key"): item.get("value")
+            for item in node.get("attrs") or []
+            if isinstance(item, dict)
+        }
+        if attrs.get("op_type") == "Conv2d":
+            convs.append((node["id"], attrs))
+    assert any("embed" in node_id for node_id, _attrs in convs)
+    assert any(
+        "layer" in node_id and "convolution" in node_id for node_id, _attrs in convs
+    )
+    stem = next(attrs for node_id, attrs in convs if "embed" in node_id)
+    assert stem["output_shape"].startswith("[B, 64, 112, 112]")
+    assert "conv_weight=" in (stem.get("details") or "")
+
+    # The stage depth multiplies the bottleneck body. The projection shortcut
+    # exists on the first block only, so it is counted once.
+    def _repeat(node_id: str) -> str | None:
+        node = next(node for node in graph["nodes"] if node["id"] == node_id)
+        for item in node.get("attrs") or []:
+            if item.get("key") == "repeat_count":
+                return item.get("value")
+        return None
+
+    body = next(
+        node_id
+        for node_id, _attrs in convs
+        if "s2_6x_" in node_id and "shortcut" not in node_id
+    )
+    shortcut = next(
+        node_id
+        for node_id, _attrs in convs
+        if "s0_" in node_id and "shortcut" in node_id
+    )
+    assert _repeat(body) == "6"
+    assert _repeat(shortcut) == "1"

+        pytest.skip(f"Swin graph unavailable (offline / no torch): {exc}")
+    if not spec.nested_module_groups:
+        pytest.skip("meta module tree unavailable (instantiation failed)")
+    return payload["graphCollections"][0]["graphs"][0]

+    ids = " ".join(node.get("id") or "" for node in swin_graph["nodes"])
+    assert "PatchMerging" in ids or "downsample" in ids

+PATTERN_NAMES = ["k0", "k1", "k2", "k3", "k4", "k5"]

+def _make_gpu_operations(names, stream=0, start_ts=0.0):
+    ops = []
+    ts = start_ts
+    for name in names:
+        ops.append(
+            pattern_finder.GPUOperation(name=name, ts=ts, dur=1.0, stream=stream)
+        )
+        ts += 1.0
+    return ops
+
+
+def _make_kernels(names, stream_id=0, start_ts=0.0, with_stream=True):
+    kernels = []
+    ts = start_ts
+    for name in names:
+        k = {"name": name, "ts": ts, "dur": 1.0}
+        if with_stream:
+            k["stream_id"] = stream_id
+        kernels.append(k)
+        ts += 1.0
+    return kernels
+

+    assert op.end_ts == 12.5

+    op = pattern_finder.Operation(name="a", ts=1.0, dur=3.0)

+                "Concrete Inputs": [""] * 7 + ["385", "32"],
+            }
+        }
+        assert moe_ext.moe_sorting_opus_fwd(bad_moe).bytes() is None
+        # moe_buf present but its dtype is absent from the type list -> bytes None.
+        short_types = {
+            "args": {
+                "Input Dims": [[8, 7], [8, 7], [1824], [1824], [57], [2], [8, 6144]],
+                "Input type": ["int", "float", "int", "float", "int", "int"],
+                "Concrete Inputs": [""] * 7 + ["385", "32"],
+            }
+        }
+        assert moe_ext.moe_sorting_opus_fwd(short_types).bytes() is None
+
+    def test_bounded_mx_quant_guard_branches(self):
+        base_dims = [[8, 7168], [12384, 224], [8, 7168], [12369], [2]]
+        scalars = ["", "", "", "", "", "8", "32", "56", "385", "32", ""]
+        types = [
+            "c10::Float8_e4m3fn",
+            "c10::Float8_e8m0fnu",
+            "c10::BFloat16",
+            "int",
+            "int",
+        ]
+        # Bounded config valid, but the activation shape is empty -> no rows.
+        no_rows = {
+            "args": {
+                "Input Dims": [[8, 7168], [12384, 224], [], [12369], [2]],
+                "Input type": types,
+                "Input Strides": [[], [], []],
+                "Concrete Inputs": scalars,
+            }
+        }
+        model = pext.fused_dynamic_mx_quant_moe_sort_hip_bounded(no_rows)
+        assert model.param_details["bounded"] is True
+        assert model.flops() is None
+        assert model.bytes() is None
+        # Broadcast stride on a counted operand -> bytes None.
+        non_dense = {
+            "args": {
+                "Input Dims": base_dims,
+                "Input type": types,
+                "Input Strides": [[0, 1], [224, 1], [7168, 1]],
+                "Concrete Inputs": scalars,
+            }
+        }
+        assert (
+            pext.fused_dynamic_mx_quant_moe_sort_hip_bounded(non_dense).bytes() is None
+        )
+        # Unreadable output dtype -> bytes None.
+        bad_out = {
+            "args": {
+                "Input Dims": base_dims,
+                "Input type": ["weird"] + types[1:],
+                "Input Strides": [[7168, 1], [224, 1], [7168, 1]],
+                "Concrete Inputs": scalars,
+            }
+        }
+        assert pext.fused_dynamic_mx_quant_moe_sort_hip_bounded(bad_out).bytes() is None
